text:
Stuttgart’s median asking rents sit at 15.98 €/m², only 0.1 % higher year‑on‑year and 15.3 % above the five‑year level, keeping the city the third‑most expensive of the 37 surveyed. The asking premium over existing rents is 54 %, with a typical 60 m² unit costing about 959 € per month.

The market remains balanced but tight: properties stay on the market for 29 days on average and 23 % are let within a week. Vacancy is low at 1.8 % and rent‑burden for two residents is 18.3 %, reflecting limited affordability despite modest population decline.

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 16.7 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 16.35 €/m² and 17.22 €/m², implying a 4.5 % increase.
